text:
The change adds loyalty point calculation and batch crediting. There is one blocking bug: orders for the same customer overwrite each other’s credits.

Using the test’s memory store, an initial balance of 3 and orders worth 12 and 4 points produce 7 instead of 19. Both concurrent updates read 3 before either writes. The tests miss this because they use different customers. Serialize updates per customer, or use an atomic increment.
